##### Project general facts

Parkwood Residences is a beautifully designed community-style development created for warm, family-focused living. The project offers a wonderful variety of homes to suit every lifestyle, ranging from smart studios and one-bedroom apartments to spacious two- and three-bedroom residences, as well as impressive three-bedroom duplexes. With its low-rise, boutique feel and thoughtful design, Parkwood Residences delivers a truly welcoming and modern place to call home.

Residents are treated to an exceptional collection of amenities set within lush, landscaped courtyards filled with palm trees and greenery. The development features sparkling swimming pools, a fully equipped state-of-the-art fitness centre, and a delightful children's play area complete with a splash pad and playground. Elegant lounge spaces, secure parking, and green communal areas complete a resort-inspired lifestyle that the whole family can enjoy every day.

Inside, every home is finished to an outstanding standard, blending warm timber tones with a bright, contemporary palette for a calm and sophisticated atmosphere. The residences come as smart homes and boast premium Scavolini luxury kitchen cabinets, adding a touch of Italian craftsmanship to daily living. Expansive floor-to-ceiling windows fill each space with natural light, while refined fittings and quality materials create interiors that feel both effortlessly stylish and wonderfully comfortable.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the heart of Dubai, Jumeirah Village Circle, or JVC, is a vibrant and rapidly growing community that captivates residents and visitors alike. This idyllic circular-shaped neighborhood is designed to offer a harmonious blend of modern living and natural beauty.

JVC's tree-lined streets, tranquil parks, and spacious villas and apartments make it a truly unique and welcoming place to call home. The community exudes a sense of peace and balance, providing a welcome escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, while still being conveniently located within Dubai.

Residents of JVC enjoy a host of amenities, including schools, shopping centers, parks, and recreational facilities, all thoughtfully integrated into the community's design. It's a place where families thrive, professionals find a convenient home, and nature lovers revel in the serene surroundings.
